summary: Master advanced statistical data analysis with our comprehensive Excel training course. Enhance your skills and make data-driven decisions effectively.
lede: Advanced statistical analysis in Excel helps analysts turn business data into defensible conclusions. It is designed for professionals working with operational, financial, quality, customer, or workforce data who need to assess patterns and differences. You will practice preparing datasets, choosing and interpreting statistical tests, evaluating regression and forecast results, and communicating assumptions and uncertainty through charts, dashboards, and recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use Excel to analyze operational, financial, commercial, quality, workforce, or customer data and need stronger statistical rigor.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with a current desktop version of Microsoft Excel that supports Power Query, PivotTables, charts, and the Analysis ToolPak. The core exercises use standard Excel features and supplied datasets, so advanced Excel add-ins and programming experience are not required. Statistical concepts receive practical explanation before application, while regression diagnostics, ANOVA, forecasting, and simulation receive intermediate-to-advanced treatment rather than production-level statistical programming.
